sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The present petition is filed by the petitioners seeking for a writ of certiorari to quash the general award passed by respondent No.3-KIADB on 11.05.2020 in respect of property bearing Survey No.108, measuring 06 acres 24 guntas situated at Mudigere Kaval Village, Kasaba Hobli, Sira Taluk,
Tumkur District and for a further direction to the respondents to consider the case of the petitioners as per Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act, 1966.

2. It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that though as on the date the general award was passed there was neither any litigation pending nor was there any impediment for the respondents to pass the consent award as per Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act, 1966, the Respondent No.3 proceeded to pass the general award NC: 2023:KHC:33311 and that in view of the law laid down in Smt. Rathnamma vs. The State of Karnataka in W.P.No.31702/2018 dated 29.11.2018 passing of the consent award under Section 29(2) is not only beneficial but would also put an end to the challenge to the award.

entities.text: Smt. Rathnamma vs. The State of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, he submits that the general award in the circumstances be set aside and the respondents be directed to pass the consent award.

3. In response, Sri.P.V.Chandrashekar, learned counsel for respondents -KIADB submits that the issue involved in the present petition is covered by the order dated 29.11.2018 passed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court in W.P.No.31702/2018.
He further submits the present petition may also be disposed of, subject to the directions issued in the said order.

4. Heard and perused the records.
NC: 2023:KHC:33311 5.

Under the identical circumstances, this Court in its order dated 29.11.2018 passed in W.P.31702/2018 while allowing the writ petition, has issued following directions:
"4.

In view of the above, this writ petition succeeds in terms of the decision cited above; a Writ of Certiorari issues quashing the impugned award dated 13.4.2017 at Annexure-E so far as it relates to the lands of the petitioner only for the purpose of determination and payment of the compensation as if the award is by agreement under Section 29 (2) of the Act, leaving the vested title to the land in the respondent-KIADB, otherwise unaffected".
6.
In that view of the matter, petitioners are also entitled to the benefit of similar order.

Hence, the following:

The respondents are directed to consider the case of the petitioners in terms of the order/directions extracted herein above within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
